name: Thermo Nunc 167008 96 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Thermo Scientific Nunc MicroWell 96 well, Nunclon Delta-treated, flat-bottom microplate, clear, sterile, with lid. Dimensions from Thermo Fisher product specification drawing D03031 'F96 MicroWell Plate, High Flange, PS' (Roskilde site), cross-checked against plate guide brochure D10948 p.20-21. Units in meters. Base length 127.8 mm (A), base width 85.5 mm (B), overall height 14.4 mm +/- 0.2 (F). Well spacing (pitch) 9 mm (K); the drawing dimensions the spacing once, so the 9 mm y pitch is not separately vendor-confirmed. A1 well center is 14.3 mm from the left edge (H) and 11.3 mm from the top edge (J). Well top diameter 7.0 mm (G1), bottom diameter 6.2 mm (G2), inside depth 11.4 mm (L), flat bottom. Total well volume 400 uL, working range 50-250 uL. Well bottom thickness is not published; the difference between the inside and external well-floor standoffs implies about 1.1 mm. The two vendor documents disagree on the inside-well-floor standoff (3.0 mm in D10948 vs 3.2 mm in D03031). Thermo states all its microplates meet ANSI/SBS 1-2004. Note that drawing D03012 covers a different pinch-bar mould and does not apply to this part. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers. SKIRT AND BODY, from Thermo drawing 2817 v10 (the technical data sheet): the body above the skirt is 123.3 x 81.2 mm, both printed, centred on the footprint, with its two row-H corners cut off at 45 degrees, 7.7 mm along each leg, and its row-A corners square (upper_outline); the chamfer is not printed and is scaled off the top view (the body's side line turns diagonal 9.9 mm from the front edge and meets its front line 9.9 mm from each side, against the printed 127.76 mm footprint). The long sides carry a skirt 7.5 mm tall and the ends a foot 2.4 mm tall, each out to the footprint. At the ends the body's end wall runs straight down to the foot, and the long-side skirt wraps round each corner to meet it (the drawing's 3D view), so the skirt outline splits each long side where the end wall is, 2.25 mm from each end, and skirt_height gives the long sides 7.5 mm and the corners and ends 2.4 mm. The line the side view draws 2.94 mm from each end is the tangent edge of the skirt's rounded corner, not where it stops. The heights are not printed: they are scaled off the drawing's side and end views (7.44 / 7.57 mm and 2.42 / 2.38 mm, against the printed 14.4 mm height, 123.3 mm length and 81.2 mm width).
